 Washington, D.C. (7News) — Ahead of the Washington Spirit's first playoff match on Sunday, CEO Kim Stone joined Good Morning Washington to preview the fan experience.
 The Washington Spirit will host the Portland Thorns in a playoff match at 3 p.m. Sunday, marking the team’s third consecutive season with a home playoff game.
 Stone recapped the incredible season had by the team and what to expect from the weeks ahead.
 You can grab tickets to this Sunday's game here.
